purpose: Keep regression protection, generalization testing, owner discovery and future real-human discovery as separate evidence streams.
hardRule: Never collapse synthetic-regression, synthetic-mutation, owner-unknown and live-human into one quality score.

synthetic-regression.meaning: Frozen annotated cases that detect behavioral regression, source mismatch and false confidence.

synthetic-mutation.meaning: Seeded unseen surface forms generated from stable intents. Generated strings are ephemeral.

owner-unknown.meaning: Questions the owner genuinely wants answered without a pre-known correct answer. Used to expose missing synthesis capability, not to train a route.

live-human.meaning: Future privacy-safe evidence from real external use. It reveals what the product is missing and must never be numerically drowned out by synthetic traffic.
